source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-maincb-initial-raw-inclusion — There are universal D_0 < infinity and e_0 > 0 such that, in every finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra with epsilon <= t <= e_0, the scalar map lambda |-> lambda*I_A is an extended D_0*t-inclusion; if dim A = 1, it is bijective.
